urls.title: Document URLs
urls.description: Public links to PDF, DOCX, XLSX, XLS, CSV, HTML, TXT or MD files (max 100). Type is detected from the file bytes, not the extension.

files.title: Files (base64)
files.description: Optional inline files for agents that hold the bytes: `[{"name": "report.pdf", "base64": "..."}]`. Keep under ~9 MB total (input size limit).

maxChars.title: Max characters per document
maxChars.description: Token budget per document (about 4 characters = 1 token). Cut at a paragraph boundary; 0 = no limit. You pay only for the pages actually returned. Default 50000.

pages.title: PDF page range
pages.description: PDF only: pages to convert, e.g. `1-10`, `5`, `20-`. Default all (up to maxPages).

maxPages.title: Max PDF pages
maxPages.description: Safety cap on PDF pages per document. Default 200.

chunkSize.title: Chunk size (characters)
chunkSize.description: For RAG: split each document into chunks of about this many characters on heading/paragraph boundaries, each with its heading and page number. 0 = off (default).

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap (characters)
chunkOverlap.description: Characters repeated between consecutive chunks. Default 200.

includeFullMarkdown.title: Return full markdown with chunks
includeFullMarkdown.description: When chunking, also return the whole `markdown` field (doubles output size). Off by default.

pageMarkers.title: PDF page markers
pageMarkers.description: Insert `<!-- page N -->` before each PDF page so citations can point at a page.

keepLinks.title: Keep hyperlinks
keepLinks.description: Keep `[text](url)` links from DOCX/HTML. Off saves tokens.

maxRowsPerSheet.title: Max rows per sheet
maxRowsPerSheet.description: Spreadsheets: rows per sheet rendered as a markdown table. Default 500.
